gen-gf-klee-one-fs-spline-sans: Graceful describes Klee One, whose terminals stop well short of the bowl and whose outline never thins. Spline Sans adds open curves, and the pair is comfortable in modest helpings.
gen-gf-klee-one-outfit: Hand-lettered and friendly, Klee One clips its terminals short of the bowl while Outfit bends cable-like curves that finish early. Warm handwriting against uniform line is the draw; long paragraphs would tire it.
gen-gf-konkhmer-sleokchher-fs-paquito: Paquito, a confident serif, keeps its lowercase close to cap height. Beneath the tall-waisted display letters of Konkhmer Sleokchher, extended reading would feel dense, so brief text works better.
gen-gf-koulen-fs-paquito: Tight, bent-paperclip letters: that's Koulen, with no thinning at the bowls. Paquito, a confident serif with lowercase nearly matching its caps, stays friendly for a short run but would tire beyond that.
gen-gf-kristi-fs-bespoke-sans: Open c forms that never close into rings give Kristi its casual, handwritten ease. Bespoke Sans stays sharp with generous space at curve ends, made for brief bursts of reading.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-outfit: A mild letterpress shimmer of weight changes gives Lakki Reddy its hand-drawn, relaxed look. Outfit does the opposite best, holding cable-like curves with no heavy-to-light shift, comfortable in modest helpings.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-space-grotesk: Lakki Reddy writes with hand-drawn looseness, its strokes tapering only slightly, while Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a constant ribbon. Extended reading would feel steady but is comfortable only in modest helpings.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-spline-sans: Liu Jian Mao Cao packs casual, single-thickness glyphs tightly, with very narrow room around every letter. Spline Sans brings the relief, with wide gaps at curve ends, comfortable in modest helpings.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-synonym: Liu Jian Mao Cao scribbles fast, narrow, and casual, one thickness throughout. Synonym takes the opposite job, a plain stripe of ink with generous openings in every curve, comfortable in modest helpings.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-outfit: Outfit bends smooth cable-like curves that finish before they close, free of any swelling. Outfit beside Liu Jian Mao Cao is a sharp turn from tight handwriting to smooth sans, good for brief lines.
